shots.subject_action_outcome: Three visual strands from the evidence groups converge toward the shared pressure on the rain-fed urban system, without selecting a winner. → The competing explanations remain credible and intertwined.
shots.narrative_function: Shows that all three explanations possess a plausible motive.
shots.description: A restrained oil-painted analytical composition in navy and amber: three separate case strands converge toward one vulnerable water-dependent city system, with the connections remaining suggestive rather than definitive.

shots.scene: Tikal - reservoir basin beneath the monumental center
shots.subject_action_outcome: A broad, low reservoir lies below the shadowed mass of Tikal's urban center, leaving the question of which pressure matters most unresolved. → No single cause is yet visually declared decisive.
shots.narrative_function: Holds the central question open against the system at risk.
shots.description: A somber oil illustration of Tikal's reservoir basin and surrounding monumental center, lit only by a distant amber lantern glow; exposed banks and still water invite an unanswered comparison.

shots.subject_action_outcome: A traced path leads from climate-record evidence toward the visibly diminished reservoir, indicating where the accumulated evidence points. → The investigation narrows toward water stress.
shots.narrative_function: Turns the open comparison into an evidence-led direction without claiming certainty beyond the record.
shots.description: Oil-painted analytical reconstruction: a climate archive trace and the reservoir are connected by a single amber-lit line across a dark field, while all surrounding details recede into navy-black haze.

shots.subject_action_outcome: The reservoir's receded waterline and dry stepped banks dominate the frame under a single warm lantern source. → Drought becomes the leading explanation in the visual argument.
shots.narrative_function: Names drought through its concrete effect on the rain-dependent city.
shots.description: A wide oil-painted view of drought at Tikal's reservoir: low water exposes dark basin walls beneath amber lantern light, with heavy brushwork, mist, and a blackened perimeter.

shots.scene: Tikal - reservoir edge and climate evidence detail
shots.subject_action_outcome: A close view isolates layered climate-record material beside the marked low-water line, making the supporting case tangible. → The drought conclusion rests on multiple visible lines of evidence.
shots.narrative_function: Closes on the concrete evidence supporting drought's strong case.
shots.description: Extreme close oil-painted evidence view: pale climate-record layers and a sharply visible former waterline catch one amber lantern glow against deep navy darkness, with textured canvas grain.

shots.subject_action_outcome: A lantern-lit view settles on Lake Chichancanab's dark, still shore, introducing the source of the drought investigation. → Lake Chichancanab is established as the starting point for the evidence trail.
shots.narrative_function: Opens the investigation at the climate archive where the evidence begins.
shots.description: Oil-painted illustration in deep navy and amber, with thick brushwork, canvas texture, mist, and black-fading edges; a single lantern casts warm light across the lake margin.
